description: Ready-to-paste code that mounts one Terudo Element in a page, for HTML, React, Next.js or Vue, with the trip data given. Optionally the server code for an element session (client discount, trusted email, reference, return URL).

days.description: plans: adds daily plans of that length.

destination.description: ISO country code (MA, JP) or region (EU-35).

element.description: Which element: booking-banner (confirmation page), trip-offer (visa approval, trip page), plans (destination page), destination-picker (shop), esim-gift (a free eSIM from a campaign; always with an element session, falls back to booking-banner), esim-status (customer area).

email.description: Traveller email to prefill, when the page knows it.

key.description: A publishable key pk_live_… or pk_test_…. Default: the public demo key.

locale.description: fr, en, de, es, it, pt, zh, ar or hi. Default en.

return_url.description: Where the checkout sends the traveller back.

session.description: Also give the server code creating an element session.

name: elements_snippet
title: Code for a Terudo Element
